subject: Architecture compatibility briefing — agenda, pre-reads, and one last slot nudge
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@omnifinance.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Architecture compatibility briefing + suggested windows

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at OmniFinance wants to follow up with a technical deep-dive focused on integration points, network/egress, and how Redwood handles model fallbacks. Can you help us schedule a 60–75 minute architecture compatibility briefing with your infra lead and a runtime engineer?

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Thu Aug 12, 09:30–10:45 or 15:30–16:45

Goals: align on network requirements, certs/KMS approach, KV cache sizing assumptions, and a short Q&A on deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

If you can also share a short agenda and any pre-reads (slides, diagrams) that would be much appreciated — our security folks want the network diagram and data flow ahead of time.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform Integrations
OmniFinance

Attachment: none in this note

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@omnifinance.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@omnifinance.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Architecture compatibility briefing + suggested windows

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear goals. Marissa (infra) and I can take the deep-dive. We prefer Aug 11 to avoid a calendar clash, but we can accommodate one of your suggested windows if needed. Proposed options (PST):

- Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:15 (preferred)
- Tue Aug 10, 14:00–15:15 (backup)

I've attached a short agenda draft and an initial slide deck for context. Pre-reads included: brief agenda, runtime responsibilities matrix, and a short checklist for your security team. Marissa will add network diagrams and ops runbook excerpts in a follow-up.

Agenda (draft):
1) 5m — Intros & objectives
2) 15m — High-level Redwood runtime & deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
3) 20m — Deep-dive: network, KMS, certs, and data flow (Marissa)
4) 15m — KV cache / batching & latency SLO impact (Jordan)
5) 10m — Q&A + next actions / integration checklist

Attachments: arch-brief-v1.pdf (pdf, 6 slides)
Action requested: please confirm which of the three attendees from your side will join (security + infra + product) so we can tailor the runbook pages.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: arch-brief-v1.pdf

Quick note from infra — adding the ops/network diagram and runbook snippets to the pre-read folder. We have an internal conflict on Aug 11 morning; if Omni can do Aug 11 at 14:00 PDT that would be ideal. Otherwise we will hold the Aug 10 afternoon slot as backup.

Drive pre-reads (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcXYZ-arch-pre-reads

Stephanie — can you send the calendar invite once Sarah confirms attendee list?

–Marissa
Marissa Cole

I'll include an explicit attendee list and a short pre-call checklist in the invite (network ports to expect, recommended testing windows, and an ask to bring any existing VPC/VPN configs).

—Stephanie
